protein phosphatase 2A is recruited to ASK1 by AIP1 to dephosphorylate pSer967 on ASK1, resulting in ASK1 activation.
PP2A-Aip1 complex facilitates ASK1 activation and apoptosis.

the molecular mechanisms of tumor necrosis factor (TFN)-induced apoptosis.
the role of protein phosphatases and protein-protein interactions in signal transduction.
the molecular mechanism of TNF-induced activation and deactivation of the ASK1-Jnk signaling pathway.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PP2A is a key phosphatase for dephosphorylating ASK1 pS967 and AIP1 recruits PP2A to dephosphorylate ASK1 at the pS967 residue.
AIP1 recruits PP2A to dephosphorylate ASK1, resulting in ASK1-JUNK activation and cell death.

PP2A-AIK1 is a novel signaling complex that facilitates ASK1-JNIK signaling in TNF-induced endothelial apoptosis.

PP2A-A1P1 complex plays a critical role in TNF-induced AS1K-JNK activation.
